title: PPBench Pencil Puzzle Repr50
description: Fifty PPBench puzzles selected to preserve the broad type coverage and public solve-rate shape of the full curated 300-puzzle split.

selection_rule.candidate_pool: The 300 puzzles listed by the public PPBench puzzle browser on 2026-04-23.
selection_rule.type_structure: 20 puzzle types with 15 puzzles per type.
selection_rule.base_selection: Per type, sort by solve_rate_percent ascending and select within-type ranks 5 and 11 (1-indexed).
selection_rule.rebalance_selection: Use a dynamic-programming pass to add one extra puzzle to 10 types so the 50-puzzle subset matches the target solve-rate histogram.
selection_rule.result: 10 types contribute 3 puzzles and 10 types contribute 2 puzzles.

leakage_policy.public_material: Puzzle type, dimensions, sanitized local play HTML path, PPBench play URL, Puzz.Link pzpr URL, and public aggregate model-solve statistics.
leakage_policy.private_material: private/answer_key.jsonl contains evaluator-only official encoded answer material matched to the selected puzzle ids.
leakage_policy.agent_exposure_rule: Expose public/ to solving agents. Do not expose private/ or raw PPBench bundled jsonl files to solving agents.
leakage_policy.omitted_from_public: Official answers, encoded answers, move traces, run artifacts, replay links, AI result tables, and per-run timing data.
